long_biography.plain_text:
El Daba's business lineage began when Ahmed Ibrahim Eldaba established TECHNOFT to represent international electrical and technology suppliers in Egypt. DABATCO later extended the family platform into import-export, engineering and communications. In 1992, Hatem Ahmed Eldaba and his brothers received the companies and continued their expansion across the Gulf and other markets.

As owner and group chairman, Eldaba helped reorganise the inherited businesses into a diversified holding company spanning trading, property, hospitality, food, entertainment, technology and design. He remained closely associated with DABATCO's broadcast and communications activity while developing the wider portfolio through subsidiaries and joint ventures. His son Adam later became chief executive, leaving Hatem in the strategic chairman role within a three-generation family enterprise.

uncertainties.detail: Identity is resolved at confidence 99 through the exact Hatem Ahmed Ibrahim Eldaba name on DABATCO's supplier listing, official Hatem Ahmed Eldaba family-company profile, Dubai operating base and the authoritative record's Emirati nationality and UAE residence. No competing person with the same four-part name and company combination was found.

Sources alternate among Eldaba, El Daba and El-Daba. The dossier preserves the authoritative record's full Hatem Ahmed Ibrahim Eldaba display name; El Daba is used only as the official company style, and no name correction is proposed.

The authoritative record identifies Eldaba as Emirati and resident in the United Arab Emirates. Company history establishes Egyptian origins for the family businesses but does not establish a second nationality, birthplace or birth country for Hatem, so those fields remain unfilled.

The company page calls Hatem founder and group chairman of the present holding structure, but its chronology says his father founded TECHNOFT and passed the predecessor businesses to Hatem and his brothers. The biographies therefore use owner-chairman and second-generation operator, avoiding any claim that Hatem created the original family enterprise.

Technology is selected for wealth creation because the transferred platform originated in electrical, communications and technology representation before later diversification. Diversified describes the current portfolio because no reliable source quantifies a dominant present sector. Inherited and expanded reflects the explicit family transfer and subsequent growth; the legal form and percentages of that transfer are not public.

The official portfolio includes IKA Venture Capital and specialist directories describe a family investment office, but public AUM, allocation and realised-investment data are unavailable. Venture capital is therefore not treated as a defining personal specialization, and inactive conglomerate, diversified group owner, communications executive and real estate investing tags are also excluded.

The exact official company profile is proposed as Company Website. A LinkedIn directory result for HATEM EL DABA in Egypt lacked enough public employer or role information to verify an exact URL, and no defensible personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, personal website, Wikipedia page or dedicated Forbes profile was found.

No reliable public source reviewed establishes Eldaba's birth date, birthplace, education, secondary nationality or residence history. Promotional profit, portfolio-scale and project-value claims are excluded from the biographies.

All vessel names, ownership periods, specifications, values, movements and holding structures are excluded from both biographies and all wealth classifications. Private addresses, inferred personal stakes, asset counts and personal net-worth estimates are also omitted.
